Package javax.microedition.broadcast

The main package for the Mobile Broadcast Service API.

See:
          Description

Interface Summary
ServiceComponent Represents a service component associated with a service.
ServiceContextListener ServiceContextListener defines the interface to listen to events from a ServiceContext.
 

Class Summary
ServiceContext The ServiceContext class abstracts the concept of a broadcast receiver.
 

Exception Summary
BroadcastServiceException BroadcastServiceException is thrown by a function when an error occurs due to some broadcast service related problems.
InsufficientResourcesException InsufficientResourcesException is thrown when there is not enough resource to complete the tried operation.
UnsupportedOperationException UnsupportedOperationException is thrown when the designated (optional) operation is not supported.
 

Package javax.microedition.broadcast Description

The main package for the Mobile Broadcast Service API.

This package contains classes and interfaces to access the digital television receiver via ServiceContext. ServiceComponent abstracts the individual components the broadcast service consists of. More information can be found from their documentation.
